formula.name: Green Patchouli Cologne V4 — Citrus Patchouli Chypre
formula.body:
### STEP 1 — BASE (add first, swirl after every 3)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 1 | Patchouli EO | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 2 | Clearwood | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 3 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 4 | Ambrox Super | 30% w/v | 300 | 0.300 |
| 5 | Vetiver EO | neat | 280 | 0.280 |
| 6 | Romandolide | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 7 | Cedramber | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 8 | Ethylene Brassylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 9 | Habanolide | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 10 | Coumarin | 20% in EtOH | 150 | 0.150 |
| 11 | Evernyl | neat | 25 | 0.025 |

**Base subtotal: 2,805 µL**

---

### STEP 2 — HEART (add second, swirl after each)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 12 | Hedione | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 13 | Iso E Super | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 14 | Lavender EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 15 | Geraniol | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 16 | Vanillin | 10% in DPG | 300 | 0.300 |
| 17 | Dihydrojasmone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 18 | Azarbre | neat | 30 | 0.030 |

**Heart subtotal: 1,490 µL**

---

### STEP 3 — TOP (add last, work quickly, cap immediately)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 19 | Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 20 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 21 | Petitgrain EO | neat | 50 | 0.050 |
| 22 | Black Pepper EO | neat | 80 | 0.080 |

**Top subtotal: 650 µL**

---

### STEP 4 — ETHANOL

| # | Material | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----|----|
| 23 | Ethanol 96% | 25,055 | 25.055 |

Add in 3 portions (~8 mL each). Swirl 15 seconds between each.

---

**Concentrate: 4,945 µL (16.5%) · Total: 30,000 µL · 30 mL · 21 materials**

---

## MUSK SWAP RATIONALE

| Musk | In V3 | In V4 | Effect |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| Galaxolide 50% | 700 µL | — | Removed. Laundry-clean projection fights dark chypre |
| Romandolide | 250 µL | 250 µL | Kept. Woody-clean luxury — the "your skin" musk |
| **Ethylene Brassylate** | — | **300 µL** | Added. Creamy lactonic depth — supports Vanillin-patchouli axis. Substantivity 0.92 |
| **Habanolide** | — | **200 µL** | Added. Translucent warm skin veil. VP=0.1 Pa |

Combined effect: "expensive dark skin" instead of "clean laundry."

---

*V4 — musks replaced for darkness + creaminess. All materials verified against inventory.txt.*

diagnostics: ℹ Dense lipophilic base — deep skin absorption, slow evolution
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Patchouli EO, Patchouli EO, Clearwood, Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate
Perceptual channels: 15 (8 cross-adaptation groups + 7 solo materials) from 22 ingredients
Channel model: 15 materials collapsed into 8 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• musk: Habanolide, Ethylene Brassylate, Romandolide (3 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Clearwood, Ambrox Super (3 → 1 channel)
• citrus_terpene: Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF (2 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 2.0% of formula mass affected by OR variants
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
ℹ Near character-shift boundary: Hedione, Iso E Super — small dose changes could shift perceived character
Far-field: Lavender EO, Dihydrojasmone, Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF, Petitgrain EO
Mid-field: Patchouli EO, Ambrox Super, Vetiver EO, Cedramber, Coumarin
Near-field: Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate, Romandolide, Ethylene Brassylate, Habanolide

═══ MIXING PROTOCOL: Green Patchouli Cologne V4 — Citrus Patchouli Chypre ═══
Materials: 22 | Total: 100.0%

─── WARNINGS ───
⚠ CRYSTALLINE SOLIDS: Coumarin, Vanillin — dissolve in warm solvent before adding.

─── PHASE 0: DISSOLUTION ───
  1. Dissolve Coumarin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.
  2. Dissolve Vanillin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.

─── PHASE 1: BASE LAYER (foundation) ───
  Step 3. Add Habanolide (4.04%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 4. Add Ambrox Super (6.07%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 5. Add Ethylene Brassylate (6.07%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 6. Add Cedramber (5.06%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 7. Add Iso E Super (5.06%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 8. Add Benzyl Salicylate (6.07%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 9. Add Romandolide (5.06%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 2: HEART LAYER (character) ───
  Step 10. Add Patchouli EO (8.09%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 11. Add Vetiver EO (5.66%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 12. Add Black Pepper EO (1.62%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 13. Add Clearwood (7.08%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 14. Add Azarbre (0.61%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 15. Add Petitgrain EO (1.01%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 16. Add Hedione (10.11%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 17. Add Evernyl (0.51%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 18. Add Dihydrojasmone (1.21%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 3: TOP NOTES (sparkle) ───
  Step 19. Add Grapefruit FCF (2.43%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 20. Add Geraniol (4.04%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 21. Add Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian (8.09%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 22. Add Lavender EO (3.03%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

  Seal tightly and store in a cool, dark place.

  Check at day 7 for initial impressions.
